native_work: number per cubic meter using one call dry-density snapshot
entry: n=rho_call*eta; existing native entry/process limits unchanged
density_refresh: new density snapshot on each microphysics call/RK time
radius: final native volume number before eta return; no empirical radius correction

input_restart_boundary: explicit UDM_NUMBER_POLICY metadata; missing is legacy0; mismatches refused in both directions

tested_scope: one periodic 2x2x59 SCM, scalar_adv_opt=0, GNU serial REAL32 plus manufactured UDM at two dry densities
